description: This source file defines a singleton object 'AppRepositories' which provides access to repository instances for cart and notifications data. It manages singleton initialization with thread safety and exposes public methods to retrieve repositories and aggregate data like cart item count and unread notifications count.

methods.name: cart
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of CartRepository, initializing it lazily with thread safety.

methods.name: cartItemCount
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the total quantity of all items in the cart.

methods.name: notifications
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of NotificationsRepository, initializing it lazily with thread safety.

methods.name: unreadNotificationsCount
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the count of unread notifications.
